meta.title: HOI AN, Vietnam 🇻🇳 | A Place We Fell in Love With
meta.description:
We spent five days exploring Hoi An, Vietnam 🇻🇳 — wandering through the lantern-filled streets of Hoi An Ancient Town, trying delicious Vietnamese food, visiting local shops, and enjoying the little moments along the way. 🤍

From our first lantern boat ride along the Thu Bon River and rainy evenings in Ancient Town to custom clothing and leather goods made by local tailors, cozy cafés, and plenty of good food, here's a little look at our five days in Hoi An.

It's easy to see why Hoi An became one of our favorite places to visit in Asia. 🤍

Just another chapter of our family travels, taking things slow and enjoying wherever the days take us. 😊

Thanks for spending a little time with us! 🤍

📍 Places featured in this vlog:
Hoi An Ancient Town
Japanese Covered Bridge (Chùa Cầu)
Annam Heritage Hotel
White Rose Restaurant
Bamboo Restaurant & Coffee
Pretty My Leather Store
May May Tailor 
Madam Khanh Banh Mi Queen
Bánh Mì Phượng
Maison Marou Hoi An
